channel.description: Latest articles from The Highland Times (thehighlandtimes.com)

item.title: Highlands and Islands Alba Members Vow to Fight on After Emergency Meeting
item.description: Alba Party members in the Highlands and Islands have voted to fight on and seek a members ballot after an emergency meeting amid uncertainty over whether the party will contest the May 2026 Scottish Parliament election.The post Highlands and Islands Alba Members Vow to Fight on After Emergency Meeting appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Green Freeport Projects Secure UK Funding Boost for Highland Growth
item.description: Two Inverness and Cromarty Firth Green Freeport sites have secured UK Government funding to unlock development and jobs, supporting environmental studies and planning work aimed at driving long-term investment in the Highlands.The post Green Freeport Projects Secure UK Funding Boost for Highland Growth appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: £100,000 of Cocaine Seized on A9 Near Crubenmore
item.description: Two people have been arrested after cocaine worth an estimated £100,000 was seized during a vehicle stop on the A9 near Crubenmore, with police highlighting the impact of drug supply on Highland communities.The post £100,000 of Cocaine Seized on A9 Near Crubenmore appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Leaders Respond to US and Israel Strikes on Iran
item.description: First Minister John Swinney and Scottish Greens MSP Patrick Harvie have issued statements following US and Israeli strikes on Iran, urging de-escalation and warning of the risks of a widening regional conflict.The post Scottish Leaders Respond to US and Israel Strikes on Iran appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Man Robbed at Knifepoint in Inverness Car Park
item.description: A 28 year old man was robbed by three masked individuals in a supermarket car park on Tomnahurich Street in Inverness at 2.10am on 1 March 2026, with police appealing for witnesses and CCTV footage.The post Man Robbed at Knifepoint in Inverness Car Park appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Six Months on SNP Hails ScotRail Savings for Highland Commuters
item.description: Six months after peak rail fares were scrapped in Scotland, the SNP says commuters on routes including Elgin to Aberdeen and Nairn to Inverness have already saved hundreds or even thousands of pounds.The post Six Months on SNP Hails ScotRail Savings for Highland Commuters appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Fiona Hyslop Backs Emma Roddick in Inverness and Nairn Campaign Push
item.description: Fiona Hyslop has visited Inverness to back Emma Roddick’s campaign for the Inverness and Nairn seat, as the SNP highlights its Highlands record and sets out priorities ahead of the May 2026 election.The post Fiona Hyslop Backs Emma Roddick in Inverness and Nairn Campaign Push appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Buckie Engineer Wins National Award for Inspiring Girls into Renewables
item.description: Kiera Wright from Buckie has been named Supporting Net Zero Apprentice of the Year at the Scottish Apprenticeship Awards, recognised for her renewable energy expertise and her work inspiring girls into engineering careers.The post Buckie Engineer Wins National Award for Inspiring Girls into Renewables appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Seeks Urgent Commons Update on Escalating Iran Crisis
item.description: SNP Foreign Affairs spokesperson Stephen Gethins has called for an urgent Commons update on the escalating Iran conflict, urging the UK Government to clarify its legal position and outline plans for de-escalation and diplomacy.The post SNP Seeks Urgent Commons Update on Escalating Iran Crisis appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Ground Floor Home in The Heart of Salen on Mull
item.description: Located in the village of Salen on the Isle of Mull, 1 Morvern View is a three bedroom ground floor flat with garden and detached brick shed, offering practical island living in a central and well connected setting.The post A Ground Floor Home in The Heart of Salen on Mull appeared first on The Highland Times.
